LESSON: WRITING 14.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: DESCRIPTIVE WRITING (200 – 240 WORDS)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.5: Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words), part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you describe your best friend? 2. How can you describe some things in your school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify features of a person, a thing, or a place that can be described,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. articulate signs of vocabulary related to features of a person, thing or place,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. write a descriptive composition on a given subject,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. underscore the importance of creative writing in communication. ● In groups, learners are guide to watch a signed demonstration or video of signs related to features of a person, thing or place and sign them. ● In pairs, learners are guided to view videos or pictures of people, things or places and list the features of each that can be described in an essay. ● In pairs, learners are guided to search online and offline for words and expressions that can be used to describe different features like weather emotions, events, and characters and sign them. ● In groups, the learners are guided to explain the difference between descriptive writing and other forms of writing. ● In groups, the learners are guided to read samples of descriptive essays and classify the features that are described and the expressions used in a graphic form for sharing. ● Individually, learner is guided to create a descriptive composition of between 200 to 240 words on an 1. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: Learner makes observations as they write the descriptive composition clearly and creatively.

● Collaboration: Learners engage in teamwork as they peer review of each other’s work, thus improving quality.

Values:
● Unity: is enhanced as learners engage each other to view videos or pictures of people, things, or places.

Link to other Subjects

● The learner relates the concept of descriptive writing to their learning in all other learning areas.
